verdict.rationale: Floot publishes an official remote MCP server (OAuth, streamable-http, listed in the MCP registry) that external agents such as Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude and ChatGPT can connect to. Through it they can build and ship full-stack apps, read logs, run SQL and migrations, and create checkpoints, so an outside agent can drive the builder instead of Floot's built-in one. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an external agent working alongside the built-in assistant on the same project, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and a probe showing the endpoint is live.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one
